title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
jobDescription:
Role Overview: As a Graduate Engineer Trainee, you will begin your career by learning to build and optimize scalable and secure systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and support. This role offers hands-on experience in developing backend and frontend components, understanding cybersecurity principles, and contributing to building robust Saa S solutions. Requirements

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Learn and understand Insta Safe’s cybersecurity products, architecture, and features. Assist with coding, debugging, and testing software components. Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to enhance products. Participate in network and security solution setup and troubleshooting. Provide technical support and documentation for product usage and issues. Stay updated on cybersecurity and cloud technology trends. Follow Agile processes and contribute actively in team sprints. Technical Skills: Basic programming and debugging skills (preferably in languages relevant to Saa S/cybersecurity). Fundamental understanding of networking, security principles, and cloud technologies. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle. Willingness and ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies. Behavioral Abilities: Adaptability: Quickly adjusts to new roles, tools, and environments. Problem-solving: Demonstrates analytical thinking and ability to approach challenges confidently. Execution: Delivers quality work with attention to detail and accountability. Collaboration: Works well in teams, communicates clearly, and supports peers. Benefits Career Growth Opportunities: Successful trainees can advance into roles such as Software Engineer, QA Engineer, Dev Ops Engineer, Cybersecurity Analyst, or Technical Support Engineer. Why Join Insta Safe? Join a bold, mission-driven team where your ideas matter. At Insta Safe, you’ll build cutting-edge security tech that protects global enterprises. We value innovation, collaboration, and a hacker mindset—here, you own your work and grow with the best minds in the industry. title: Technical Writer
jobDescription: About Insta Safe Insta Safe is a fast-growing B2B cybersecurity Saa S company focused on securing the future of work through Zero Trust security solutions. We help enterprises protect applications, users, and data across cloud and hybrid environments using technologies such as Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Our culture is professional, growth-oriented, and accountability-driven. We operate as a lean, high-impact team that values clarity, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer trust at scale. Role Overview As a Technical Writer, you will play a critical role in translating complex cybersecurity and cloud-security concepts into clear, accurate, and actionable documentation for customers, partners, and internal teams. Your work will directly improve product adoption, customer success, support efficiency, and overall trust in Insta Safe’s security platform. This role owns Insta Safe’s public and internal documentation experience and continuously evolves it using best practices, data insights, and modern tooling. Duties & Responsibilities Take end-to-end ownership of https://docs.instasafe.com/ including content accuracy, structure, discoverability, versioning, and ongoing improvements aligned with product releases. Create, edit, and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including product guides, how-to articles, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, release notes, and known-issue documentation. Develop and manage internal documentation such as SOPs, support playbooks, escalation workflows, and operational runbooks for Support, Product, and Engineering teams. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, Technical Support, and Customer Success teams to gather information and ensure technical accuracy. Structure and organize content within documentation platforms or Knowledge Base systems to ensure high discoverability, usability, and consistency. Ensure all documentation adheres to Insta Safe’s documentation standards, tone, style guides, and quality benchmarks. Proactively identify documentation gaps by analyzing support tickets, customer feedback, release changes, and internal requests. Manage the end-to-end documentation lifecycle, including versioning, periodic reviews, updates, and deprecation aligned with product evolution. Track and report documentation effectiveness using metrics such as SEO effectiveness, article usage, support case deflection, and time-to-resolution insights. Requirements Qualifications & Skills Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Minimum 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in a B2B Saa S, cybersecurity, cloud, or technical support environment. Core Technical Skills Strong ability to understand and document complex technical systems and workflows clearly and concisely. Working knowledge of cloud and networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, authentication, authorization). Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts such as Zero Trust, IAM, MFA, SSO, secure access, or Saa S security architectures. Familiarity with modern AI-powered tools for documentation, research, content improvement, and workflow automation (e.g., MKDocs, AI writing assistants, search augmentation, summarization, or documentation automation tools). Excellent written English, with strong editing, proofreading, and information-structuring skills. Ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Preferred / Good-to-Have Experience working with ticketing or service platforms (e.g., Zoho Desk, Gitlab,Zoho One tools). Exposure to API documentation, developer-facing content, or tools such as MKDocs, Postman, Git/Git Hub, Markdown, or basic HTML. Experience creating diagrams, workflows, or visuals using tools like Lucidchart,Canva or similar. Prior experience in a cybersecurity, cloud security, or enterprise Saa S startup environment. Benefits Career Value Proposition At Insta Safe, your work as a Technical Writer will have real, visible impact—helping enterprises securely operate in a Zero Trust world while enabling internal teams to move faster and smarter. You’ll gain deep exposure to modern cybersecurity architectures, collaborate with experienced product and engineering leaders, and grow alongside a rapidly scaling Saa S company. We offer a supportive, high-ownership culture with strong learning opportunities, competitive compensation, health insurance benefits for yourself and parents including OPD that covers routine medical requirements such as day-to-day doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, prescribed medicines, and similar outpatient treatments.—designed for professionals who value meaningful work, continuous growth, and accountability in building mission-critical security products. title: Frontend Developer
jobDescription:
About

ROLE:
As a Frontend Developer at Insta Safe, you will play a crucial role in building visually engaging, responsive, and high-performing user interfaces that align with our brand's identity. You will work closely with the design team to turn concepts into functional web applications, ensuring a seamless user experience across all devices. Your responsibilities will include writing clean, reusable code, optimising frontend performance, and collaborating with backend teams to integrate RESTful APIs. Additionally, you’ll ensure cross-browser compatibility, troubleshoot issues, and implement accessibility standards to create inclusive digital experiences. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge projects in cybersecurity while collaborating with a dynamic and innovative team. Key Responsibilities User Interface Development: Collaborate with the design team to build responsive, visually appealing, and user-friendly interfaces, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines. Efficient Frontend Code: Write clean, efficient, and reusable code for frontend components while optimising performance across various devices (memory, CPU). Debugging and Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, and debug and extend front-end libraries when required. Pixel-Perfect Design Implementation: Work with Sigma for design collaboration and prototyping, ensuring pixel-perfect UI implementation and smooth communication with design teams. Cross-Browser and Device Compatibility: Ensure consistent functionality and visual integrity across different browsers and devices through rigorous testing and optimization. API Integration: Collaborate closely with backend teams to integrate and consume RESTful APIs, ensuring seamless data flow and interactivity between frontend and backend systems. Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor, analyse, and optimise application performance through techniques such as caching, load management, and resource optimization for scalable and high-performing frontend solutions. Accessibility and Usability: Apply WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) standards and best practices to create accessible and inclusive user experiences for all users. Requirements

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. Experience: 4-6 years in software development, with a primary focus on Golang in production environments. Frontend Expertise: Strong proficiency in modern frontend development frameworks and tools, particularly Angular JS, HTML5, CSS3, and Java Script. Experience with PHP (Laravel framework) is a plus. Design and Prototyping Tools: Proficiency in using Figma for collaborating on designs and prototyping. Web Performance Optimization: Understanding of performance optimization techniques, including caching strategies, load management, and working with servers like Apache and Tomcat. Cross-Browser and Device Testing: Experience in ensuring compatibility and consistent performance across multiple browsers and devices. Experience in website enhancement and maintenance is highly desirable. Soft Skills: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact effectively with cross functional teams Proactive attitude towards problem solving and continuous improvement Ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines Strong organizational and multitasking abilities Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high quality work Self Motivated with the ability to adapt to evolving technology and organizational needs Benefits Opportunity to work with one of the leading companies in cybersecurity Dynamic and collaborative work culture Involvement in cutting-edge projects in Zero Trust Security About

title: Backend Software Development Engineer (Java/Go Microservices)
jobDescription: About Insta Safe Insta Safe is a Zero Trust cybersecurity company trusted by global enterprises to secure users, applications, and infrastructure in hybrid and cloud-native environments. Our ZTNA, IAM, and MFA solutions protect over 500,000 endpoints worldwide, enabling enterprises to adopt cloud securely and confidently. We are seeking a Backend Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core backend services that power ISA Controller and ZTA Console. These services form the backbone of our Zero Trust platform, handling authentication, authorization, secure session management, and large-scale API integrations. Role Overview The Backend Engineer will design and implement scalable backend services and microservices using Java (Spring Boot) and Go (Golang). You will work across authentication flows, distributed session management, REST/g RPC APIs, and cloud-native orchestration, ensuring the platform is secure, performant, and highly available. This role is ideal for engineers with deep backend expertise and an interest in secure enterprise systems. Duties & Responsibilities Service Development: Design and implement backend services for authentication, authorization, and Zero Trust access policies using Java Spring Boot and Go. Microservices Architecture: Build and scale modular, stateless services orchestrated via Docker/Kubernetes. API Development: Design, document, and optimize REST APIs and g RPC interfaces for secure communication with agents and consoles. Data Management: Integrate and optimize Postgre SQL, My SQL, Mongo DB, and Redis for secure and efficient data storage. Authentication & Security: Implement OAuth2, JWT, SAML, LDAP integrations to connect with enterprise identity providers. Performance & Reliability: Benchmark, monitor, and tune backend systems for scalability and low latency. Collaboration: Work closely with frontend, agent, and gateway teams to deliver cohesive platform features. CI/CD Integration: Contribute to automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment workflows. Continuous Learning: Stay current with cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and secure coding practices. Requirements Qualifications & Skills Education & Experience: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 4–8 years’ experience in backend development for enterprise-grade systems. Core Technical Skills (with links for TA reference): Java & Spring Boot Go (Golang) REST APIs & g RPC Postgre SQL, My SQL, Mongo DB, Redis Docker & Kubernetes OAuth2, JWT, SAML, LDAP Preferred/Good-to-Have: Experience with message brokers (Kafka, Rabbit MQ). Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Experience in high-performance distributed systems. Exposure to Dev Sec Ops practices. Benefits Career Value Proposition Build the core backend brain of a fast-scaling Zero Trust cybersecurity platform. Work with cutting-edge Java and Go microservices. Collaborate with top engineers across frontend, networking, and endpoint teams. Gain career growth in distributed systems and enterprise security platforms. Follow-Ups & Action-Item Ownership • Drive and chase follow-ups across sales, marketing, finance, and external stakeholders, being relentlessly resourceful to resolve open action items within deadlines and budgets. • Manage lead coordination, routing, and assignment, ensuring no lead or deal stalls for lack of follow-through. • Maintain a live action-item / open-items tracker and escalate blockers early to keep everything moving to closure. Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting • Support pipeline management and sales forecasting, ensuring opportunities are accurate and up to date. • Build and maintain weekly/monthly reports and dashboards (Zoho Analytics / Google Sheets) for sales leadership. • Assist with quota, territory, and account assignments and keep supporting documentation current. jobDescription: About Insta Safe Insta Safe is a fast-growing B2B cybersecurity Saa S company focused on securing the future of work through Zero Trust security solutions. We help enterprises protect applications, users, and data across cloud and hybrid environments using technologies such as Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Our culture is professional, growth-oriented, and accountability-driven. We operate as a lean, high-impact team that values clarity, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer trust at scale. Role Overview Are you a logical thinker with a passion for emerging technology? We are seeking fresh graduates from Mathematics and Computer Application backgrounds who are not just "tech-savvy" but "AI-curious." In this role, you will combine your analytical mathematical mind with AI tools to help us build the next generation of Zero Trust security. You will learn to use AI to write better test cases, find vulnerabilities faster, and automate the mundane, allowing you to focus on high-level security problem-solving. Duties & Responsibilities AI-Assisted Testing: Leverage AI tools (like Chat GPT, Git Hub Copilot, or specialized LLMs) to brainstorm complex test scenarios and generate initial test scripts. Analytical Validation: Apply mathematical logic to verify that our security protocols are foolproof, ensuring no "edge case" is left unexamined. Security & Vulnerability Detection: Learn to identify system weaknesses and use AI-driven scanners to interpret security threats like SQL injection or unauthorized access. Smart Automation: Assist in building automated test suites, using AI to help debug code and optimize performance scripts. Continuous AI Learning: Proactively explore and suggest new AI tools that can improve the speed and quality of our QA processes. Requirements Qualifications & Skills: Education & Experience: Fresh Graduates (2023/2024/2025 batch) with a B.Sc. in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a BCA. Core Technical Skills: Superior logical reasoning. Basic understanding of programming logic. High proficiency in using Gen AI tools for research, learning, or basic coding tasks. AI Curious Mindset: You should be someone who has experimented with AI tools and is excited about how AI is changing the software world. Preferred / Good-to-Have: Participation in AI hackathons, a prompt engineering certificate, or a blog/project showcasing your use of AI. Benefits Career Value Proposition: At Insta Safe, your work as a Junior QA Analyst will have real, visible impact—helping enterprises securely operate in a Zero Trust world while enabling internal teams to move faster and smarter. You’ll gain deep exposure to modern cybersecurity architectures, collaborate with experienced product and engineering leaders, and grow alongside a rapidly scaling Saa S company. We offer a supportive, high-ownership culture with strong learning opportunities, competitive compensation, health insurance benefits for yourself and parents including OPD that covers routine medical requirements such as day-to-day doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, prescribed medicines, and similar outpatient treatments.—designed for professionals who value meaningful work, continuous growth, and accountability in building mission-critical security products. title: Linux Systems Engineer
jobDescription: About Insta Safe Insta Safe is a Zero Trust cybersecurity leader, helping global enterprises secure users, applications, and infrastructure across hybrid and cloud environments. Our Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions protect over 500,000 endpoints worldwide. We are seeking a Linux Systems Engineer to build secure endpoint agents that extend Zero Trust policies to Linux-based systems. This includes the ISA Linux Agent and ZTA Linux Agent, which integrate with authentication protocols, PAM modules, and networking components to ensure secure, policy-driven access to enterprise applications. Role Overview The Linux Systems Engineer will design, develop, and maintain system-level Linux agents. The role requires proficiency in C/C++, PAM module development, Open SSL, and Linux networking internals. You will work on deep OS integrations (systemd, daemons, packaging), enabling Linux endpoints to act as fully trusted nodes in the Zero Trust ecosystem. Duties & Responsibilities Agent Development: Design and implement secure Linux endpoint agents for Zero Trust authentication and access control. Authentication Integration: Develop and extend Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) for MFA, SSO, and secure login enforcement. Networking & Security: Work with iptables/netfilter, TLS/SSL (Open SSL), and VPN/ZTNA protocols to secure data in transit. System-Level Work: Develop systemd services, daemons, and ensure proper Linux packaging (.deb, .rpm). API Integration: Connect agents with backend controllers/gateways using REST APIs and secure token exchanges (OAuth2, JWT). Debugging & Troubleshooting: Use Linux system debugging, logging, and packet inspection tools to resolve issues. Collaboration: Partner with cross-platform teams (Windows, Mac, Android, i OS) to ensure feature parity across endpoint clients. Continuous Learning: Keep updated on Linux kernel and security enhancements, applying them to strengthen endpoint security. Requirements Qualifications & Skills Education & Experience: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 3–6 years of experience in Linux systems software development. Core Technical Skills: C Programming / C++ Shell Scripting (Bash) Linux Systemd PAM Modules Open SSL Linux Networking (iptables/netfilter) Deb/RPM Packaging REST APIs Preferred/Good-to-Have: Experience with kernel modules or low-level drivers. Familiarity with container environments (Docker/Kubernetes). Knowledge of Zero Trust / VPN protocols (IPSec, Open VPN, Wire Guard). Familiarity with SELinux/App Armor security frameworks. Benefits Career Value Proposition Build mission-critical Linux endpoint security agents used in Fortune 500 enterprises. Work on deep system-level programming that combines authentication, networking, and security. Collaborate with world-class engineers across OS platforms. Gain expertise in Zero Trust security and enterprise networking protocols.
